title: What changes when Bitcoin is your money?
deck: Conviction is a beginning. A budget, a clean balance sheet and a household that understands the plan turn conviction into a way of living.

title: Give today’s money a job
deck: A bank balance tells you where money is. A budget tells you what it must do, when it is needed and what changes when you choose something else.

title: Bring the future back home
deck: Debt assigns future income before that income exists. This framework aims for zero debt, including obligations that have acquired respectable names.

title: Give money a direction beyond yourself
deck: After zero debt, giving becomes a funded category in the money layer. It trains attention toward the people your work and resources can serve.
part: III · Money that moves toward others

title: Let Bitcoin serve an ordinary life
deck: Income, bills, saving and spending need a workable rhythm. Bitcoin becomes money through its place in those decisions, not through a refusal ever to use it.
part: IV · Live with Bitcoin as money

title: Know what your wealth is doing
deck: Money, consumption assets and productive assets can have identical price tags and very different consequences. The balance sheet makes those differences visible.
part: V · Build a strong balance sheet

title: Read the price through time
deck: A long-term model can put today’s exchange rate in context. Its usefulness depends on keeping history, assumptions and household obligations distinct.

title: Make the next large decision clearly
deck: A worthwhile purchase, a productive investment and money held for later have different purposes. Compare them honestly without asking a calculator to choose your life.

title: Make the money usable beyond one person
deck: Operational services, long-term custody and family instructions have different jobs. A sound plan protects the money and gives the right people a path to it.

title: Build the next thirty years from an ordinary hour
deck: Bring the pieces into a written policy, a realistic sequence and a review rhythm. Then look far enough ahead to see why the ordinary work matters.
